lines.text: David flees from Naioth in Ramah to Jonathan and says there is but a step between him and death.
David plans to hide in the field until the third evening and tells Jonathan to say he went to Bethlehem.
Jonathan tells David to wait beside the stone Ezel and says he will shoot three arrows to its side.
At the New Moon meal Saul sits beside Abner, and on the second day he asks Jonathan why David is absent.
Saul hurls his spear at Jonathan, who leaves the table in fierce anger and eats nothing that day.
